sources.title: How much does Fusion cost (Autodesk blog)

limits.en: Fusion for personal use: free for non-commercial hobbyist projects, reduced feature set

keyLimits.en: Non-commercial use only, reduced CAM/CAE/PCB features vs paid tier
Full CAD, CAM, CAE and PCB design toolset; commercial use allowed
Custom quote; typically $150/user for a 3-year term, up to 10 users per approved startup, eligibility conditions apply

addOns.en: Manufacturing and Design extensions priced separately, roughly $595-1,465/year

cautions.en: Annual subscription equivalent is $680/year (~$57/month), notably cheaper than the $85/month month-to-month rate.

capabilities.en: Combines CAD, CAM (manufacturing), CAE (simulation) and PCB/electronics design in a single tool
Built-in cloud data management and collaboration for design files

limitations.en: Free personal-use tier is restricted to non-commercial projects only
Advanced manufacturing and design capabilities require separately priced extensions on top of the base subscription

reason.en: Alternative 3D design tool, though more architecture/interior-design oriented than mechanical CAD.
Alternative 3D and simulation-capable tool used in adjacent design/production workflows.
